crossRefs.note: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother, who were also in the boat…
Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after…
He allowed no one to follow him, except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by…
He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.
Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.
When the woman of Tekoa spoke to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, showed respect, and said, “Help, O king!”
Now I ask one petition of you. Don’t deny me.” She said to him, “Say on.”
Then she said, “I ask one small petition of you; don’t deny me.” The king said to her, “Ask on, my mother; for I will…

people.name: James
people.line: Son of Zebedee, one of the Twelve Apostles

people.name: Zebedee
people.line: Father of the apostles James and John

translations.web: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”
translations.bsb: Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to Jesus and declared, “Teacher, we want You to do for us whatever we ask.”
translations.kjv: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.
translations.asv: And there come near unto him James and John, the sons of Zebedee, saying unto him, Teacher, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall ask of thee.
